summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public beta/full launch of searchwoot.com; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries; counsel_required for any rights-dependent use or external permission request. Exact decision: keep the product private, keep Woot outreach unsent, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal data; public terms restrict those uses. Human counsel must review any proposed permission request and future affiliate/advertising use.

SearchWoot launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing evidence includes official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts. No task is closed because rights, field permissions, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not close tasks without direct evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance; storage, caching, derivative, display, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory and route counsel-required gaps.

Fleet compliance and evidence disposition: technical baseline is not certification—35 sites pass, 18 fail, and 6 are unknown, with open banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is yellow because some GA4/GSC permissions or collector results are unavailable; do not treat unavailable telemetry as zero and do not block ordinary growth solely for that reason. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21: $4.92 aggregate commission cannot be assigned to a site; site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecasts, and causal lift remain unknown. Recommendation: continue only bounded reversible work using existing data, disclosures, consent, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries; do not expand monetization or make unsupported claims.

Concrete private-site decisions: complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net remain parked/private and preview-only. No public launch, publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, or spend is authorized. Existing owner-gap work remains active. Next evidence action: attach dated execution-owner verification, preview/build evidence, compliance and security checks, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker for each site by 2026-09-30T17:00Z; reconsider only after the packet and required technical, security, measurement, and legal gates are evidenced.

Continue containment-only execution from a legal perspective. Do not create duplicate proposals, requeue unchanged failures, deploy, add dependencies, add telemetry, spend, expand affiliate or advertising use, or conduct external outreach. Existing measurement, repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, security evidence, launch-readiness, and owner-gap work may continue where it adds no new data collection or rights-dependent behavior.
